page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Margin note in the right margin, beside "objicient,". Signature at the foot, right of centre. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right.

main_text.p: ferentiæ si[?] referatur ad objectu, nempe pro in-differentia objectiva judicii proponentis objectū, quod nempe voluntas velle vel nolle poteft, pro sua natura quippe quia non magis læderetur essentia libertatis, si libertas hoc potius quā illud amplecteretur, tum facile solveretur quæstio: sed quia difficile est cum protervis adversariis limites quæstionis figere, quo fata disputationis nos ducant, sequi & persequi hostes oportet.

At contra hanc indifferentiam objicient,Vide Remonstr. in apolog. exam. cens. ap. 7. fol. 81. talem indifferentiam competere causæ naturali, nam non-calefactio non magis lædit essentiam & actum primum ignis, quam calefactio. Sed respondeo, quamvis in casu miraculi salvetur essentia ignis sub non-calefactione, non tamen salvatur naturalis modus agendi in igne. At nec actus primus, nec actus secundus potentiæ liberæ lædituer, sive voluntas hoc velit, sive non. Dabimus itaque duplicem indifferentiam in potentia liberâ, aliam objectivam, nempe quando intellectus proponit eligibile libertati ut medium summo bono absolutè intento non necessarium, aliam internam, vitalem, electivam, qua voluntas libera ex se poteft tam hoc velle, quam nolle, salva tum essentia libertatis, tum salvo naturalissimo agendi modo suo.

9. Hinc prima nostra assertio. Voluntati liberæ in se & formaliter convenit indifferentia hæc & objectiva & interna, & per hanc à non coactione, à spontaneitate, & ab omnibus causis naturalibus formaliter distinguitur.

page.notes: The left margin carries only the printed rule line and no text. The margin note beside "objicient," is set in small type over several lines; its wording is read partly by reconstruction and the abbreviations "cens." and "ap." are doubtful. The word "lædituer" is as printed; it may be a misprint for "lædituer" or "læditur". The first word of the page "ferentiæ" continues a word from the previous page; the initial letter of the "si" sign is doubtful. Catchword "liber-" and signature "A 5" are at the foot.
